about: Every moderation decision the inbox can ask for (ADRs 0102, 0103 and 0105), generated from openblog_core::moderation and checked by crates/openblog-core/tests/moderation_inbox.rs; netlify/lib/participation-moderation.mjs must agree with every case. Each case starts at version 3; facts: plain (revision 1, nobody asked, no consent), consented (revision 1, consent), asked (revision 1 asked about), answered (revision 2, revision 1 asked about). Regenerate with OPENBLOG_BLESS=1.
